title: Bedrock messages stream drops exception events and returns 200 with an empty body

assertions.why: the provider's error message must reach the client as an error event

observed: Exception-only stream yields HTTP 200 with 0 bytes; an exception after a delta just stops. The client cannot tell failure from completion.

sse: {"validationException":{"message":"The model returned the following errors: Could not process image"}}

notes: The mock must emit AWS event-stream frames with an exception message; the sse list holds the logical event.
